turns.text: Good match! I am Ravi, and I play CS:GO with my team every night. What games do you like to play?
yo i like cs too. i play valorant more now, the aim is more better and I was play cs go like 3 years
Valorant is fast, and good aim is so important there! Where do you live? My team and I play every night.
i live in Czech, near Brno. i like valorant because the games is fast and i can play with my friends every day. also because the agents are cool, more better than cs
Brno sounds nice! I am in India, so our game nights are at different times. What time do you usually play?
i play usually after school, like 7 pm, and on weekend more late. what time you play, is it not like middle of night for you?
It is very late for me, about 10:30 at night, but not middle of night! Which country are you from?
i already said, czech republic lol. you ask me this before. 10:30 is ok, i play also late on friday, like 1 am, my mom is angry
Oops, sorry for asking again! Friday at 1 am is very late, so I hope your mom calms down. What game do you play with your team on Friday?
on friday we play valorant ranked, me and 4 friends. we are like gold rank and we want to go platinum but my friend he don't listen, he always do stupid things lol
Gold to platinum is a big goal, good luck! Your friend sounds funny. What do you like most about ranked games?
